metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent demonstrated capability to edit slides in LibreOffice Impress: opened Slide menu, navigated dialogs, applied formatting changes. Transitions are a different but closely related slide property accessible via the Slide Show menu.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, open dialogs, apply slide-level properties to all slides.
metadata.failure_analysis: Original failure was on background color application scope. Transitions use a different menu path (Slide Show > Slide Transition) and have a clear 'Apply to All' button, making this task more achievable.
metadata.task_rationale: Targets a different but related slide property (transitions vs background). Uses demonstrated 'edit presentation slides' capability. The Slide Show > Slide Transition panel has an explicit 'Apply to All Slides' button, which is simpler than the background dialog flow that caused the original failure.
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening Slide Show menu > Slide Transition, selecting Fade effect, and clicking 'Apply to All Slides'. Getter parses OOXML <p:transition><p:fade/></p:transition> elements in the saved PPTX. Initial state has no transitions, so score = 0.0 (negative-control safe). llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly parses OOXML transition elements from the PPTX file using python-pptx; <p:transition><p:fade/></p:transition> maps to type='fade' as expected.
Metric correctly requires all slides to have fade type (min_fraction=1.0), fully matching the instruction 'all slides'.
Negative-control safe: the initial file has no transitions, so getter returns type='none' for all slides and metric returns 0.0.
LibreOffice Impress exports standard OOXML <p:fade> child elements when saving .pptx, so the getter will correctly identify fade transitions set via LibreOffice.
Partial credit is available for partial completion, providing meaningful scoring signal.
